body.statement: For every \(\theta\in\Theta(G)\), the table \(\theta\) satisfies all equalities in \(\mathcal C\) if and only if each child row is constant on every class of \(\mathcal R_i\). Replacing \(\mathcal C\) by \(\mathcal R\) preserves \(\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{ocsi}}(G,\mathcal C)\), the map \(\theta\mapsto P_{\theta}(V)\), and \(q(\theta)\).
body.justification: The quotient removes syntactic overlap while preserving the exact observational fiber and causal target.
body.gap: Pensar et al. and Duarte and Solus study context-specific representations rather than preservation of latent causal-query fibers and obstruction syntax.
body.consumer: The quotient gives \(Y_0\) one canonical parameter index for exact deduplication and checking.
